title: Show HN: Kinesis – Control your Mac with the Meta Neural Band
summary: Kinesis is a project that leverages the Meta Neural Band's sEMG (surface Electromyography) sensors to enable hands-free gesture control of Mac computers. Building on an earlier proof-of-concept, it extracts neural band sensor data independently from the glasses to interpret hand movements and translate them into system controls.
problem_solved: Enables hands-free computer control using Meta Neural Band's underutilized sEMG sensors instead of relying on the glasses' built-in applications.
why_valuable: Demonstrates novel applications for consumer sEMG hardware, opening possibilities for accessibility tools, productivity enhancements, and alternative input methods beyond traditional peripherals.
